row.title: TIMELY-1: lateness is a measured failure mode, not a hope
row.body: Owner directive 2026-11-28: an Ultrastable system shall always resolve its own issues and merge its own pull requests automatically and timely. drainwatch --timely reads every repository's open issues against their priority SLA (p0 4 h, p1 24 h, p2 72 h, otherwise 7 days) and ready pull requests against 24 h, treats hold, later, gate:filed and needs-pat as declared waits, and counts an unreadable repository as unmeasured. Detector timely-resolution files it through the failure-audit as Q-AUDIT-timely-resolution. The rule text itself stays in the existing DRAIN-ALL-1 and FLOW-BALANCE-1 rules because agents/AGENTS.md is at its shrink-only size baseline. Session: session_0156nqDuSa1pdM6rAaTQ1irE
